levers.name: F-F2 drafter permutation kernels
levers.reason: the quad's K/V assembly (untilize, slice, row-major concat, tilize: about 285 us a tensor and layer), query fold and output unfold as one tile-permutation launch each on one rectangle of the compute grid, with the served round trip's zero-exponent-to-+0 rule applied to exactly the pieces it round-trips

levers.name: F-F3c fused drafter q|k|v projection
levers.reason: the quad's three drafter projections (q 52 us, k 46.5 us, v 46.6 us, three typecasts, one head split) as one matmul over a load-time [q|k|v] weight, one typecast and one head-split launch; costs 42 MB (bf8) or 79 MB (bf16) of DRAM a chip for the extra weight

levers.name: F-F4 one 64-row drafter head
levers.reason: the quad's two 32-row LM-head matmuls (2 x 891 us over the same weight shard) as one 64-row matmul; bit-identical only if the auto matmul config at M = 64 blocks K as at M = 32, which the audit decides (else tau-only)

image_files.reason: the permutation planners, the launch builder and the audit (QWEN_FAST_DRAFT_PERMUTE), imported lazily by draft_attention_branch, quad_draft_tp, pair_row_exact_tp and draft_qkv_tp
JIT source of the permutation kernel (tiles and quarter tiles, the canonical rule)
the fused q|k|v projection and its head split (QWEN_FAST_DRAFT_QKV1), imported lazily by draft_attention_branch
the 64-row drafter head (QWEN_FAST_DRAFT_HEAD64), imported lazily by quad_draft_tp
the WP7 log rule (an engaged line per site and shape, a passing audit line per quad site, no fell-back line)

notes: Hooks are env-gated inside the twins this package owns (quad_draft_tp, pair_row_exact_tp, draft_attention_branch, draft_shared_head_tp), so no tp_addresses row is needed. Needs from the integrator, outside the generated blocks: (1) test_tp4_closure_literals.SERVED must name draft_permute_tp, draft_qkv_tp and draft_head64_tp (they are lazy imports of served modules); (2) the image copy-closure test treats them as plain imports, so the overlay lines above must be in both copy lists or the closure test must read the overlay; (3) the card-M job scripts/ci/references/fusion-jobs/WP7/P7-cardm-permute-bytes.env needs no dispatch (the cardm action runs optimisation/ttnn-op/draft_permute/run_card_m.sh). The octo fold and unfold are NOT hooked (octo_draft_tp.py is not WP7's file); they are planned and tested (draft_permute_tp.fold_records/unfold_records with halves=2 users=4 block=8) and the hook is six lines in octo_draft_tp.octo_fold_query / octo_unfold_output, the same as quad_draft_tp.quad_fold_query's.
